mintAuthority.summary: EUROe was a Finnish EMI-licensed euro EMT issued by Membrane Finance (later Paxos Issuance Europe), now in redemption-only wind-down. The five EVM deployments and the independent Solana SPL mint are reviewed as native issuance routes. MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE remain EOA-held on the EVM routes, while Solana has a separate non-multisig mint authority; the EVM contracts use UUPS upgrade paths with no timelock.

controls.label: Membrane/Paxos MINTER_ROLE EOA
controls.capDescription: No on-chain mint cap was identified in the reviewed implementations; the active MINTER_ROLE can call mint directly on each EVM deployment.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770838, Polygon block 92144619, Avalanche block 92982043, Optimism block 155661593, and Arbitrum block 495292609 (all 2026-08-16 UTC), hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x74424510108a8ad9aa6a5b506048948e6a16706b) = true and a zero-amount mint simulation from that address succeeds on every EVM deployment. The address has no bytecode on Ethereum, Avalanche, Optimism, and Arbitrum; the Polygon bytecode read timed out during the current screen. The existing Ethereum role-history review found no revoke or migration to a multisig. These are direct native issuance gates, not bridge adapter roles.

controls.label: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE EOA (UUPS upgrade authority)
controls.capDescription: The DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE-controlled UUPS upgrade path can replace mint-critical logic and raise or remove any contract-level issuance bound; no timelock was observed.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770838, Polygon block 92144619, Avalanche block 92982043, Optimism block 155661593, and Arbitrum block 495292609 (all 2026-08-16 UTC), hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xd5731b8c97b61cdede6c612ec963b3f86af0c3f7) = true on all five EVM deployments. The common EVM implementation is 0x85c427aa5605c242ff693c1e45b8641a9cb8279d on Ethereum, Polygon, Avalanche, and Optimism; Arbitrum uses 0x64bf35bbe75445ec5fbfb59517c2d6311503c2d3. Each EIP-1967 admin slot is zero, consistent with UUPS self-administration, and no timelock or multisig migration was observed.

controls.label: EUROe Solana mint authority
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 439734038 (2026-08-16T23:09:50Z), the EUROe SPL mint 2VhjJ9WxaGC3EZFwJG9BDUs9KxKCAjQY4vgd1qxgYWVg is initialized with 6 decimals, mint authority 8ykETiDvCFHrrPP1X8McwChWFVDHbhz2cJpVEVY5GNAC, and freeze authority 8FyB12RHpTsTMbY7uNrU7SeDXmUpWik8HE1ZSFqzMaQd. Both authority accounts are System Program-owned, non-executable accounts. No SPL multisig threshold, on-chain cap, or timelock was verified; this is a separate native authority and is not inferred from the EVM EOA.

review.evidence: Reviewed at the current observations on 2026-08-16 UTC: Ethereum block 25770838, Polygon block 92144619, Avalanche block 92982043, Optimism block 155661593, and Arbitrum block 495292609. The same issuer EOA 0x74424510108a8ad9aa6a5b506048948e6a16706b has active MINTER_ROLE on all five EVM deployments and zero-amount mint simulations succeed; DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE remains held by EOA 0xd5731b8c97b61cdede6c612ec963b3f86af0c3f7. The common implementation is 0x85c427aa5605c242ff693c1e45b8641a9cb8279d on Ethereum, Polygon, Avalanche, and Optimism, while Arbitrum uses 0x64bf35bbe75445ec5fbfb59517c2d6311503c2d3; EIP-1967 admin slots are zero and no UUPS timelock was observed. At finalized Solana slot 439734038 (2026-08-16T23:09:50Z), the independent SPL mint retains mint authority 8ykETiDvCFHrrPP1X8McwChWFVDHbhz2cJpVEVY5GNAC and freeze authority 8FyB12RHpTsTMbY7uNrU7SeDXmUpWik8HE1ZSFqzMaQd, with no verified multisig, cap, or timelock. Paxos redemption-only status does not revoke these on-chain capabilities. The native issuer-direct paths remain concentrated-admin, contract-level issuance remains unbounded, FIN-FSA EMI authorization is prudential supervision, and no recurring whole-supply reconciliation was verified. The historical issuer statement about bridging is recorded under Bridge Risk; no catalogued deployment is classified as a bridge representation.
